parameters.name: ContentEncoding
parameters.description:
The encoding method for the CommandContent and Output fields in the response. Valid values:

- PlainText: returns the original script content and output.
- Base64: returns Base64-encoded script content and output.

Default value: Base64.

parameters.name: LimitBytes
parameters.description: The maximum size of the log. Unit: bytes. Valid values: 1 to 1048576 (1 MB).

parameters.name: StartTime
parameters.description: The start time in UTC, in RFC 3339 format.
